_comment: Static config, agreed once and never touched again during the build. Maps free-text `outcome` values from the cases table to one of: favorable | unfavorable | ongoing. Every member reads this file independently — it is not imported as live code. Matching is substring-based (case-insensitive) against the `patterns` lists below; the FIRST matching pattern (checked longest-first) wins, so put more specific phrases before generic ones within a bucket.
_unclassified_policy: Any outcome string matching none of the patterns above is bucketed as 'unclassified' at runtime (see outcome_mapping.py). Unclassified and 'ongoing' cases are excluded from the binary favorable-vs-unfavorable contingency table used for odds ratio / chi-square / Fisher tests, but are reported in result metadata (n_excluded_ongoing, n_excluded_unclassified) so nobody mistakes a shrunken denominator for a clean one.
